methodology.phase1: RS + Stock Momentum + Industry Rating + multi-period price strength + existing fundamental/business triggers.
methodology.verifiedEvidence: CAPEX and Industry Tailwind business triggers require company-specific verified evidence with a valid source in company_evidence.json. Automated CAPEX/Tailwind scores alone cannot create these triggers.
methodology.candidateEvidence: company_evidence_candidates.json is review-only and is not used directly to create Big Move business triggers.
methodology.structuralTriggers: Structural triggers are display-only and require a theme keyword plus company-specific action/impact evidence in the same research fragment. They do not add points to Big Move Score.

technical.priorMove: Detect prior price advance >=30% from the most recent qualifying local swing low to a prior peak.
technical.retracement: (Prior Peak - Lowest Post-Peak Base Low) / (Prior Peak - Move Start Price) × 100. Current session is excluded.
technical.consolidationDays: Completed trading sessions strictly between the detected prior peak and the current session. Prior peak day and current/breakout day are excluded.
technical.volumeContraction: Actual completed post-peak base average volume <=75% of prior move average volume. Prior peak day and current/breakout day are excluded from the base.
technical.volatilityContraction: Recent average daily range <=75% of prior move average daily range.

breakout.Near Breakout: Current close within 3% below prior peak.
breakout.Base Building: Current close within 10% below prior peak.

technical.turnoverExpansion: Current traded turnover divided by previous 20-session average turnover.

methodology.freeFloatScore: Free Float is currently displayed/filterable but NOT yet included in Big Move Score. Thresholds will be calibrated after coverage/distribution validation.
